Select explicit existing provenance, fetch linked issue numbers in GraphQL batches, reuse import lifecycle mapping, and apply audited update-only SDK transactions. Prove selection, zero creation, real lifecycle dates, missing reasons, dry-run immutability, and batch splitting.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Review round findings, all four verified valid against current source and fixed: (1) importFidelityFields assigned release:undefined when fidelity.github_release was empty, so finalization deleted an existing release on every refresh of an open issue or a closure without a matching calendar tag; the release key is now spread only when GitHub supplies one, so user/tool attribution survives (an existing import regression that asserted the deletion was deliberately re-pointed at preservation). (2) refresh selection accepted /pull/ URLs but the batch query reads issue(number:) nodes and compares /issues/ URLs, so every PR-linked item was reported as not_found_or_inaccessible or transferred on every run; selection now accepts /issues/ links only. (3) label pagination read next.data.repository.issue.labels without guarding a repository or issue that vanished between requests (transfer/delete), surfacing a plain TypeError instead of a CommandError; the connection is now validated and typed failures abort. (4) an update-only transaction derives its steps and transaction id from current item state, so a crash after the steps applied and source fields finalized left linked items matching the source: the retry counted them unchanged, never called the SDK, and the durable journal stayed in applying while the command exited 0; re-deriving after a partial apply also fingerprints a new transaction id (verified empirically: a status-changing replay derived github-import-e5d96059a6b2e12f while the journal was github-import-90df3e1ae6e5786a).

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Recovery design for finding (4): update transactions persist their exact pre-commit plan (derived transaction id, prepared entries, ordered mutations) beside the SDK journal under transactions/pm-github/ before the SDK writes; the SDK journal itself never stores the mutation list, so that record is the only replay source. runRefresh scans transactions/sdk/ for unfinished github-import journals (status applying or compensating) whose step targets intersect the selected items and replays each from the persisted plan before the unchanged filter; the replayed journal commits without re-applying completed steps, so the audit comment is not duplicated. A dry run refuses while such a journal is open; a missing or unusable plan fails closed naming the transaction id; neither writes. Ordinary no-op refreshes stay byte-stable: plans are removed after commit and their garbage is swept only when the journal is terminal or gone; the transactions directory is gitignored tracker runtime state.

(3) reverting only the label-connection guard reproduced the reviewer's plain TypeError (Cannot read properties of null, reading 'issue') and failed the pagination regression, exit 1. (4) reverting only the resume block in runRefresh made the interrupted-refresh command regression fail (Missing expected rejection for the dry-run refusal, exit 1). Restored source passes 940/940 tests including all four regressions.
